mapper.select: SELECT fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as prodid, DATE_FORMAT(ftr.vdate, '%Y%m%d') as startdate, DATE_FORMAT(ftr.mdate, '%Y%m%d') as enddate FROM FIN_PRODUCT fin, fin_trade_product ftr WHERE fin.FINPROD_ID = ftr.FINPROD_ID AND DATE_FORMAT(ftr.vdate, '%Y%m%d') < '${sysDate}' AND DATE_FORMAT(ftr.mdate, '%Y%m%d') >= '${sysDate}' AND fin.FINPROD_ID = '${prodId}'
